mapper.insert: insert into cynexus_appl_market.portfolio_review (id, principal_key, tenant_key, symbol, period_start, period_end, thesis, plan, execution, lessons, next_action, tags, rating, metrics_snapshot, status) values (#{id}, #{principalKey}, #{tenantKey}, #{symbol}, #{periodStart}, #{periodEnd}, #{thesis}, #{plan}, #{execution}, #{lessons}, #{nextAction}, cast(#{tags} as jsonb), #{rating}, cast(#{metricsSnapshot} as jsonb), #{status})
mapper.update: update cynexus_appl_market.portfolio_review set symbol=#{symbol}, period_start=#{periodStart}, period_end=#{periodEnd}, thesis=#{thesis}, plan=#{plan}, execution=#{execution}, lessons=#{lessons}, next_action=#{nextAction}, tags=cast(#{tags} as jsonb), rating=#{rating}, metrics_snapshot=cast(#{metricsSnapshot} as jsonb), status=#{status}, updated_at=now() where id=#{id} and principal_key=#{principalKey} and tenant_key=#{tenantKey} and deleted_at is null
mapper.select: select id, principal_key, tenant_key, symbol, period_start, period_end, thesis, plan, execution, lessons, next_action, tags::text as tags, rating, metrics_snapshot::text as metrics_snapshot, status from cynexus_appl_market.portfolio_review where id=#{id} and principal_key=#{principalKey} and tenant_key=#{tenantKey} and deleted_at is null

select id, principal_key, tenant_key, symbol, period_start, period_end, thesis, plan, execution, lessons, next_action, tags::text as tags, rating, metrics_snapshot::text as metrics_snapshot, status from cynexus_appl_market.portfolio_review where principal_key=#{principalKey} and tenant_key=#{tenantKey} and deleted_at is null and (#{symbol} is null or symbol=#{symbol}) order by period_end desc, id desc
